Who we are

A family company that controls every stitch.

Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Tashkent, one of the world's largest cotton-growing regions. We run five product lines in-house: denim, woven, jersey knitwear, flat-knit and outerwear, for children from newborn to 16 and for men's and women's basics.
